details_no_rag.nl_query: For each zipcode in Atlanta, give the change in average house rent from 2019 to 2022, i.e., from pre-COVID to post-COVID period.
details_no_rag.gold_sql:
select substring(housing_rent.zipcode, 7, 10) as zcta, cast((sum(number_of_units*((rent_value_min+rent_value_max)/2))/sum(number_of_units)) - h.rent_weighted_avg as decimal(8,2)) as rent_change
from housing_rent join 
(select zipcode, (sum(number_of_units*((rent_value_min+rent_value_max)/2))/sum(number_of_units)) as rent_weighted_avg
from housing_rent where year=2019 group by zipcode) as h on h.zipcode=housing_rent.zipcode
where year=2022 
group by housing_rent.zipcode

       AVG(CASE WHEN Year = 2019 THEN Rent_Value_Min END) AS Avg_Rent_2019,
       AVG(CASE WHEN Year = 2022 THEN Rent_Value_Min END) AS Avg_Rent_2022,
       AVG(CASE WHEN Year = 2022 THEN Rent_Value_Min END) - AVG(CASE WHEN Year = 2019 THEN Rent_Value_Min END) AS Rent_Change
FROM housing_rent
WHERE Zipcode IN (SELECT Zipcode FROM housing_rent WHERE Zipcode = 'Atlanta')
GROUP BY Zipcode

details_no_rag.nl_query: Get year-on-year change in GRAPI, where GRAPI is gross rent as percentage of household income.
details_no_rag.gold_sql:
select str_to_date(concat(year,'-01-01'),'%Y-%m-%d') as `Year`, sum(number_of_units*(income_percent_max+income_percent_min)/2)/sum(number_of_units) as `GRAPI`
from housing_gross_rent_percent
group by year

details_no_rag.nl_query: For each zipcode in Georgia, give the change in average house rent from 2017 to 2022.
details_no_rag.gold_sql:
select substring(housing_value.zipcode, 7, 10) as zcta, cast((sum(number_of_units*((house_value_min+house_value_max)/2))/sum(number_of_units)) - h.housing_value_weighted_avg as decimal(8,2)) as change_in_housing_value
from housing_value join 
(select zipcode, (sum(number_of_units*((house_value_min+house_value_max)/2))/sum(number_of_units)) as housing_value_weighted_avg
from housing_value where year=2017 group by zipcode) as h on h.zipcode=housing_value.zipcode
where year=2022 
group by housing_value.zipcode
